notes.title: Bloopy & Droopy Version 1.1!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are very happy to announce the release of the[b] Version 1.1[/b] of Bloopy & Droopy! What's new in this patch? Let's dig into this, right now!

[list]
[*] Some adjustements on certains levels, more particulary in Pluf Pluf River and Blocky City
[*] Your max lives increase from 5 to 10
[*] Captain Kurgos battle is now easier: less HP, attack speed of small ships have been lowered, more indications in phase 2 and less asteroids too. You also recover all your hearts between each phase now.
[*] Some minor bugs fixed
[*] We added a bunch of new languages: French, Spanish and Portuguese!
[/list]

We sincerely hope you'll have a great time on Bloopy & Droopy thanks to these modifications, have fun!

- [b]DreamVeloper Studio[/b].
